structural_report.scope_note: Checks preservation and annotation structure. Source accuracy and research coverage require editorial review.

original_prose_preserved.evidence: 100 original blank-separated blocks, 73 prose paragraphs, 14 headings and 13 Kaynaklar lines; exact validator and base hash.

no_paragraph_deleted.evidence: 73/73 claim paragraphs mapped and locally annotated; 100/100 original blocks in order.

inline_lexical_tags_preserved.evidence: 434/434 original tags in order, including 413 ar tags and 21 source-only tags.

canonical_enum_values.evidence: Parent validator has zero errors or warnings.

asbab_uncertainty.evidence: Mursal Abu Maysara chain and competing chronology are explicitly uncertain/not_assessed.

thematic_hadith_separated.evidence: Ten checked primary reports; seven thematic/historical and three direct_hadith_tafsir, matching evidence matrix relation classifications.

hadith_grades_verified.evidence: Sahih collection basis and named Darussalam/Tirmidhi/Albani authority; no grade borrowed merely from tafsir quotation.

reading_distinctions.evidence: Canonical reading vs dialect/ishmaam and noncanonical explanatory reports distinguished; reader, rawi and path explicit.

historical_context_sourced.evidence: Lexicon use and theological restraint are typed separately from certain event claims; Ibrahim nazar/munazara dispute preserved.

conflicting_reports_preserved.evidence: Makki/Madani/double revelation; hamd/shukr; basmala counting; malik preference vs canonical maalik; alternative name derivations.

every_novelty_has_checked_sources.evidence: 21 connection-specific lists; full Razi and other incomplete scopes expressly not_checked.

no_absolute_classical_absence_claim.evidence: No none_found_in_checked_sources classification; body denies universal absence and first-ever inference.

building_blocks_separated.evidence: Seven building_blocks_only, twelve partial, one explicit, one not_checked.

resonance_not_contextual_translation.evidence: Core method controls and local constraints retain primary ayah meaning; root identity and echo roots separated.

report_deduplication.evidence: Ten distinct primary hadith families get one hadith block each; later tafsir repetitions are attestations. Asbab family not multiplied.

interpretive_consequences.evidence: Local controls cover zero-shadow, anger-subject transfer, ghayr two roots, Quran prepositions, well apparatus, translation endpoint and Quran context.

reader_orientation.evidence: Three reader notes; research corpus scope at end; source registry resolves 77 IDs.

filterable_layers.evidence: Every annotation has priority, audience and tradition.
